I recently stayed at Hotel Rosa in Dar Al Beida, Algiers, and it was an extremely disappointing experience. Due to overbooking at other hotels, I ended up here, and I regret it deeply.

For 7600 DZD, I got a tiny room with a double bed. The sheets were dirty and smelled of urine, which was absolutely disgusting.

The bathroom was in horrible condition: the toilet was not working, and there was no water in it.

Everything in the room seemed broken except for the TV.

The entire hotel felt like it needed significant maintenance.

It was a very bad experience overall, and 7600 DZD was definitely not worth it. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.
